company_name: Zhangzhou Xipu Material Technology Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company produces electronic-grade gases and precursors essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhangzhou Xipu Material Technology Co., Ltd. is a specialized producer of electronic-grade gases and precursors, including fluorinated specialty gases like NF3, C4F6, and BTBAS. These materials are crucial for cleaning, etching, doping, and film-forming in semiconductor manufacturing, positioning the company as a potential Tier 1 supplier in the high-tech electronics and integrated circuit sectors.
capabilities: Supply of cleaning agents, etchants, dopants, and film-forming materials
